sources.title: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is Qwen's open-weight multimodal MoE model for coding, agentic workflows, long-context reasoning, and vision-language tasks. It has 35B total parameters with 3B activated, supports image-text-to-text use, preserves reasoning context across turns, and natively handles 262,144 tokens with extension up to about 1.01M.
